sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A cushion-forming perennial about 10–30 cm tall, with narrow basal leaves and leafless stalks topped by rounded heads of pink flowers. It occurs across the Northern Hemisphere, especially on coastal cliffs, pastures and salt marshes, often in dry, sandy, saline soils.

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: No food use is verified in the sources consulted.
